name: The Fourth Doctor
oracle_text:
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
Would You Like A...? — Once each turn, you may play a historic land or cast a historic spell from the top of your library. When you do, create a Food token. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
blocked_sentences: Would You Like A...? — Once each turn, you may play a historic land or cast a historic spell from the top of your library. When you do, create a Food token. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)

needs.what: one library-top play permission whose once-per-turn cap is shared between playing a land and casting a spell from the top of your library, filtered to historic cards (any_of: Artifact type, Legendary supertype, Saga subtype) for both the land and the spell
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_library_top and play_lands_from_library_top are separate statics: play_lands_from_library_top takes no card filter (it would allow any land, not only historic ones) and no per-turn cap, cast_from_library_top's affects_spells (LIBRARY_TOP_CAST_FILTER_KEYS) has no any_of so 'artifact OR legendary OR Saga' cannot be said, and writing both would give two independent meters (a land AND a spell each turn) instead of one shared use

needs.what: a 'when you do' trigger that fires when this permanent's permission is used to play a land or cast a spell from the top of the library, so it can create_token food_token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spell_cast and land_played triggers with from_zones: ["library"] fire for any library cast or play (another permission, a cascade, etc.), not specifically the use of this permission; no permission static carries a rider effect run on use (enters_tapped and cast_gains_keywords are the only riders)
